notes.title: MAJOR Update 2.0: PANDEMONIUM
notes.content:
[h2][i][b]This update is FREE and AVAILABLE NOW to all playtesters. To sign up, hit the request access button on the store page to immediately gain access and try it out![/b][/i][/h2]

[list]

[h1]Change Notes[/h1]

[h2]PANDEMONIUM Arrives[/h2]

[i]In the far reaches of the multiverse, a rogue automaton called PANDEMONIUM consumes energy and destabilizes stars. Programmed to increase entropy and quicken existence's rebirth, PANDEMONIUM has taken its mission to extremes, draining life from planets and galaxies, pushing the universe toward a premature heat death.[/i]

[h3]2.0 Changelist[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Rare Loot Generates with more abilities, as opposed to higher level abilities.[/b]
[*] Shotgun has been buffed to pierce up to 3 enemies per pellet.
[*] Loot has been balanced to have an even amount of each item type per level.
[*] Katana Dash reword to Katana Blink, instantly teleporting the player to the indicated location and damaging/reflecting any enemies/projectiles passed through.
[*] Overall state of economy changes.
[*] [b]Overhauled main hub area to be more visually appealing[/b]
[/list]

[/list]

Make sure to join the [url=https://discord.gg/akujCZrmaj]discord[/url] in order to gain the playtester role and provide much needed reporting/feedback.

Happy Hunting!

notes.title: PLAYTEST Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]COLLATERAL [/b]has officially began [b]playtesting[/b]. There is no official duration currently planned, but this branch will be updated with different builds in order to promote testing of the game. 

The current playtest solely includes the tutorial level, in order for players to get acclimated to the systems in [b]COLLATERAL[/b].

Although it is an open playtest, it is [i][b]highly recommended[/b][/i] to leave feedback/bug reports in the discord channel.

To directly interact with me for feedback, [b]join the discord[/b]: https://discord.gg/akujCZrmaj and follow the instructions.


Don't forget to check out the [b]Youtube channel[/b] for updates on the game: https://www.youtube.com/@COLLATERAL-GAME
